text:
Maya R: Hey team — Maya here (just started on infra). Quick question: who actually owns model routing and fallback policies? e.g., fallback to a cheaper model variant / different region when capacity is low. Also who do I ping for rollout percentages and SLA latency escalations?

Daniel P: Welcome Maya! Eng Platform owns routing policies + the rollout framework (canary/A-B/fallback). For urgent latency or production incidents ping #eng-sre and the on-call. Primary owners: @daniel_p (platform) & @theo_s (sre).

Priya S: Product owns the canary percentages and experiment definitions (what percentage of traffic, success criteria). For customer-specific rollout decisions loop in CS/your AE.

Lina G: For SDK/client-side routing behavior (deterministic routing, header-based overrides) ping #devex. If you need deploy config edits or permission to touch canary-config repo, open a ticket in #eng-infra and request the okta group redwood-deployers.

Theo S: If you hit high 99th latency or increased error rates, escalate via PagerDuty (service: Redwood-Platform) AND post to #incidents. Add the runbook tag: runbook/routing-fallbacks — runbook link: https://go.redwood/runbooks/routing-fallbacks

onboarding-bot: Maya added to the onboarding checklist (token access, okta groups). Reminder: complete the infra access form in <https://forms.redwood/onboard>.

Maya R: Awesome — thanks! Any docs or single page that maps owners to surface areas?

Daniel P: Yep — start with docs: /docs/platform/routing.md and /ops/runbooks/fallbacks.md. There's also an ownership matrix doc (internal): https://go.redwood/ownership-matrix — it lists primary/secondary for routing, rollout, billing alerts, and security. I'll DM you the permissions template for okta.

Lina G: Short escalation checklist: 1) alert -> #eng-sre and PagerDuty, 2) if it's configuration/rollout bug -> #eng-platform, 3) if customer-facing with potential data impact -> @security-team + #product.

Priya S: For product-impacting rollouts, file a PR to canary-config with the experiment metadata and tag @product-owners. We try to keep changes small and short-lived.

Daniel P: Example okta request text if helpful: ``Okta request: add Maya R to redwood-deployers, env=staging, reason='canary config edits for onboarding'``

Maya R: Perfect — that's super helpful. I'll start with the routing doc and open the infra ticket. Thanks everyone :raised_hands:
